newsitem.title: MEXICO: Samsung sees $300 mln Mexican investment.
newsitem.headline: Samsung sees $300 mln Mexican investment.

text.p: The Mexican subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co Ltd plans to invest $300 million in the country during 1997, the unit's director told Reuters on Thursday.
"In Samsung (Mexico), we invested $300 million last year, and this year we are thinking of investing another $300 million," Sang-Heung Shin, director general of Samsung Electronics de Mexico, said.

Shin said Samsung had earmarked an additional $40 million investment to manufacture microwave ovens. Samsung estimated its sales in Mexico would increase to between $75 million and $80 million in 1997 from to $50 million last year.
(( --Tomas de la Rosa, Mexico City newsroom +525 728-7912))
